name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal
task: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task "If you pick up the key, you must also open the door" is a no-timing condition with "also", matching RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) as hard. No goal is commanded, so the rule-only warning is valid. The machine's well-free rewards and the key-drop path after opening the door are consistent with the environment.

texts: If the agent picks up the key (has_door_key), the door must also be opened at some point (door_open), before, with, or after the key.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, door_open) -> u2
(u1, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, door_open, u2) -> 1
